notice: GST dates are generated from recurring GST Portal filing rules and checked against official GST advisories for extensions. TDS payment dates are shown separately from quarterly TDS return filing dates to avoid confusion. Advance tax instalments are shown on their statutory 15th-of-month dates. Due dates can differ by taxpayer category, State/UT and filing frequency. Verify the applicable date on the official portal before filing.

extension_notice.title: CBDT extends AY 2026-27 audit deadlines
extension_notice.text: For eligible audit cases, the tax audit report due date has been extended from 30 September 2026 to 21 October 2026, and the corresponding ITR filing due date has been extended from 31 October 2026 to 21 November 2026.
